normalApp: Open Settings and choose Export storage report
Save report to Files and choose the destination
isolatedEntry: Use an approved build and an idle foreground window
Open <configured CaptureCallbackScheme>://storage-report when Capture has no existing process
Check the report screen and existing-save activity
Choose Create report, then Save report to Files
flow.existingProcess: The report is presented over the existing Capture view. Settings and URL routes hold new automatic foreground work in the session before showing the report. Existing save passes and background/continued handling can still advance queued captures.
flow.backgroundEventWinsBeforeRoute: Ordinary background/explicit save-intent ownership remains valid. A subsequent report is labeled normal Capture already active; no false isolated-entry claim.
flow.coldBackgroundEvent: Cancel collection, record interruption, preserve OS completion callbacks without reconnecting or acknowledging undrained events. The user must explicitly confirm Open Capture for ordinary handling. Duplicate session identifiers are attached once and completions fan out once.
flow.return: Open Capture requires a separate confirmation that ordinary saves can resume. Canceling, backgrounding, exporting or dismissing the system file picker never opens normal Capture automatically.
flow.foregroundHold: Session-owned generation tickets block automatic scene/root/initializer/default-channel work. Cancellation, Files return, backgrounding and view dismissal retain the hold. Confirmed Open Capture releases it synchronously once; stale work stays invalid after release.

data.references: Known local-file fields, named structural embedded JSON and typed capture/directory associations; not arbitrary prose, source/provenance records or JSON keys.
data.privacy: Relative paths, arbitrary record IDs/kinds and session identifiers are hashed. Authored content, source URLs, headers, cookies, credentials and raw payloads are not exported. Recognized UUID relationships remain identifiers.
data.sqlite: READONLY | FULLMUTEX | NOFOLLOW, query_only, read transaction, bounded digest re-read; no immutable=1, migration, checkpoint or WAL deletion. SQLite may update shared-memory coordination.
data.unknown: All unprojected source/legacy fields, symlinks, external/unresolved references, OS transfers and extension/system dependencies remain unknown/preserve. Missing observed references never imply deletion eligibility.

remainingApproval: A device build, installation and an idle user-triggered export window require separate approval.
remainingReceiving: Actual cold URL scene routing and ordinary foreground/background/Shortcuts entry on the same normal binary
Actual Settings sheet keeps the existing preview workspace alive
Generate/cancel/background/file-picker cancellation and insufficient export space
Background-event interruption and explicit completion handoff within OS time limits
Export receipt identity and snapshot scope; unknown dependencies remain protected
Warm report activation, Files return and confirmed exit with the session-owned foreground hold on the normal app binary
